plan.unanswered: Identify native and Python client costs of original aggregate/ordered/select-all/insert-rollback public SQL operations after DELETE diagnosis; no speculative product optimization.
plan.product: #774 DELETE branch, not candidate; candidate e4d5 plus scoped DELETE fix, no #684 journal optimization
commands: run_sql_query_profile.py: 8 small timed cells (3 read rows,1 rollback row), 6 original-size read timed cells (34250 rows), 8 separate profile cells (34250 read rows,1 rollback row)
plan.timing: 1 preflight,3 warmups,21 measured per timed cell; full result consumption inside public call, validation/logging outside; insert includes begin/execute/rollback/handle release. One diagnostic trial only, no before/after or reference ratio claim.
plan.profile: 4-second loop separate from latency; native sample3s across all threads includes operation+validation; Python cProfile public operation only, not validation; no profile timings promoted to latency.
plan.failure: Stop on case failure; preserve failure and cleanup. Remaining independent cases may run only after classifying cause and budget.
plan.cleanup: Each fixture removed immediately. Record source, parser, binaries, raw values and stacks; remove owned package/parser/archive and native outputs after diagnosis. Keep shared deps and compact logs only.

limits: Internal single-trial macOS test-profile diagnosis, not public0.8.16/fixed/reference acceptance.
One preflight is excluded from each timed cell; profiles are separate, never pooled with raw timing.
Native sample includes validation and setup-to-loop delay; cProfile only wraps public operations and adds overhead.
RSS samples can miss short processes; absent per-case server RSS is unobserved, not zero. Max RSS and CPU lifetime include fixture setup and verification.
No per-operation IO counters or physical power-loss result.
Production code unchanged from unmerged PR774; no release-ready claim.

cleanup.retained: compact source-bound logs, raw samples, native stacks, Python profiles and shared active dependency cache only

next_action.condition: Preserve snapshot visibility, full observed-key conflict tracking, overlays/tombstones and early iterator drop while reducing eager range reconstruction. Inspect coupling and add minimal regressions before changing storage behavior.
next_action.separate_followup: RemoteDatabase._rows_to_dicts/_unwrap_sql_value strict decoding cost; retain malformed-input rejection and exact Python types.
next_action.not_duplicate: #684 PR770 changes write journal before-images; this evidence identifies range materialization beneath an already-active SQL primary-key LIMIT path.

select_all_client_instrumented.caution: Instrumentation overhead and inclusive overlap: do not derive an uninstrumented percentage or speedup.

rollback_client_instrumented.observation: begin/execute/rollback HTTP calls; rollback phase is material in server timing. No promise to remove requests while preserving API semantics.
